name: orin-whisper
description: Jetson Orin NX / Nano: Whisper base on a bare TensorRT encoder at a 30 s window, decoder as a CPU ONNX graph with a KV cache. Encoder 11.4 ms on NX, TTFT 58-83 ms. The .plan is built ON-DEVICE from the shipped ONNX and MUST use `--bf16`, not `--fp16`: the fp16 build of this graph scores cosine 0.826 against onnxruntime and fails silently, emitting fluent text that drifts off-topic. Verify with bench/perf/whisper/cmp_engine_precision.py before trusting an engine.
